holds.raw: ר' ינאי בר' שמעון ברבי (לא מצאתי)
holds.reason: Tanchuma supplies the shorter Rabbi Yannai be-Rabbi Shimon designation. Vayikra Rabbah gives Yannai transmitting Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yannai. Neither establishes the full Berabbi designation in this heading. Keep the compiler’s stated uncertainty.
